text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Sega NAOMI was an arcade system released in 1998 and shared hardware technology with the Sega Dreamcast. It used interchangeable cartridges and later GD-ROM media, allowing arcade operators to update games more easily. The system hosted titles including Marvel vs. Capcom 2, Dead or Alive 2, Virtua Tennis, Ikaruga, and Initial D. NAOMI became one of Sega's most widely used arcade platforms and remained active for many years.
